added_lines: for further information. st. eunan’s cathedr al letterkenny newsletter sunday 1st novem ber 2026 feast of saints god, lover of souls, you hold dear what you have made and spare all things, for they are yours. look gently on your servant and by the blood of the cross forgive his/her sins and failings. remember the faith of those who mourn and satisfy their longing for that day when all will be made new again in christ, our risen lord, who lives and reigns with you for ever and ever. amen. cuidigh linn éisteacht le do bhriathra: go mba údar solais dúinn sa dorchadas iad, go mba údar creidimh dúinn in aghaidh an amhrais iad go mba údar sóláis dúinn inár mbuairt iad. siné ár nguí chugat trí chríost ár d tiarna. plenary indulgence for the holy souls 1. from twelve o’clock noon on the 1st november until midnight on the 2nd november, all who have confessed, received holy communion and prayed for the pope’s intentions (one our father, one hail mary, or any other prayer of one’s choice) can gain one plenary indulgence by visiting a church or oratory, and there reciting one our father and the apostles creed. the indulgence is applicable only to the souls of the departed. confession may be made at any time within the week preceding or following the 1st november. holy communion may be received on any day from the 1st - 8th november. 2. the faithful who visit a cemetery and pray for the dead may gain a plenary indulgence applicable only to the holy souls on the usual conditions once per day from the 1st - 8th november. the conditions mentioned above apply also for this. the annual novena for the faithful departed will run from the 1st - 9th november at the evening mass. you are welcome to write a list of the names of your loved ones and to leave them in the basket which will be placed in the sanctuary for the purpose. offerings are not expected, any offering received will be used to defray the cost of light and heat. you are encouraged to attend the novena for its duration, conscious of the importance of praying for our beloved dead and for all the souls who have no one to pray for them. cathedral
